lessons.trigger_condition: Tablet market home lacked game-specific horizontal card and BOX price snapshots with observation dates and safe source links.
lessons.prevention_rule: Show only existing market data, source-date, price type, region and original links; never fabricate HOT or price change statistics from isolated observations; unknown identity stays unknown.
validation_required: game and region filter only when verified
BOX image requires verified name and region
stale observations not called live trades
existing grading and market navigation preserved
lessons.safety_boundary: No cloud compute, no invented card prices or grades, physical tablet verification separate.
